ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit pre-encryption ritual: defense disable + shadow copy wipe + backup-service kill within 15 min
ucs.description: Detects the textbook LockBit (LockBit 2.0 / 3.0 Black / Green / 5.0) pre-encryption checklist executed by affiliates immediately before dropping the locker: Defender tampering, vssadmin/wmic/bcdedit recovery destruction, and backup/SQL service stops on the same host within a tight window. This combination is signature LockBit affiliate tradecraft (documented in CISA #StopRansomware AA23-325A and Trend Micro/Sophos LockBit 3.0 reports).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" Processes.process="*delete*shadow*") OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*No*") OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*") OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" Processes.process="*delete*catalog*") OR (Processes.process_name="powershell.exe" Processes.process="*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*") OR (Processes.process_name="powershell.exe" Processes.process="*Set-MpPreference*") OR (Processes.process_name="sc.exe" Processes.process="*stop*WinDefend*") OR (Processes.process_name="sc.exe" Processes.process="*config*WinDefend*disabled*") OR (Processes.process_name="net.exe" Processes.process="*stop*MSSQL*") OR (Processes.process_name="net.exe" Processes.process="*stop*Veeam*") OR (Processes.process_name="taskkill.exe" Processes.process="*sqlservr*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval action=case(match(process,"(?i)shadow|recoveryenabled|bootstatuspolicy|delete catalog"),"recovery_destruction", match(process,"(?i)DisableRealtimeMonitoring|Set-MpPreference|WinDefend|Sense"),"defense_disable", match(process,"(?i)MSSQL|Veeam|sqlservr|backup|SQLWriter"),"service_kill") | stats min(_time) as first, max(_time) as last, dc(action) as distinct_actions, values(action) as actions, values(process_name) as binaries, values(process) as commands, values(user) as users by dest | where distinct_actions >= 2 | eval window_minutes=round((last-first)/60,1) | where window_minutes <= 15 | convert ctime(first) ctime(last)
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 15m;
let DefenseDisable = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName =~ "powershell.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("DisableRealtimeMonitoring","DisableIOAVProtection","DisableBehaviorMonitoring","Set-MpPreference","Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath"))
        or (FileName =~ "sc.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("WinDefend","Sense","WdNisSvc","WdBoot") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("stop","disabled","delete"))
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DefTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, DefCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let RecoveryWipe = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadow")
        or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
        or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled","bootstatuspolicy"))
        or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("catalog","backup","systemstatebackup"))
    | project WipeTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, WipeCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let ServiceKill = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName =~ "net.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "stop" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MSSQL","SQLWriter","Veeam","BackupExec","vss","sophos","MsDtsServer"))
        or (FileName =~ "taskkill.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("sqlservr","veeam","agntsvc","DefWatch","VirtualBox","vmware-usbarbitator"))
    | project KillTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, KillCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
DefenseDisable
| join kind=inner RecoveryWipe on DeviceId
| where WipeTime between (DefTime - WindowMin .. DefTime + WindowMin)
| join kind=leftouter ServiceKill on DeviceId
| where isnull(KillTime) or KillTime between (DefTime - WindowMin .. DefTime + WindowMin)
| summarize FirstObserved = min(DefTime), DefCmds = make_set(DefCmd, 10), WipeCmds = make_set(WipeCmd, 10), KillCmds = make_set(KillCmd, 10)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName
| order by FirstObserved desc

ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:4688 OR @EventID:1) ((@CommandLine:(*"shadowcopy delete"* OR *"shadowcopy Delete"* OR *"delete shadows"* OR *"Delete Shadows"*)) OR (@CommandLine:(*"recoveryenabled No"* OR *"recoveryenabled no"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"*)) OR (@CommandLine:(*"DisableRealtimeMonitoring"* OR *"Set-MpPreference"* OR *"Add-MpPreference"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\sc.exe OR *\\SC.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*WinDefend* OR *windefend* OR *Sense* OR *WdNisSvc*)) OR (@Image:(*\\net.exe OR *\\Net.exe OR *\\NET.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*"stop MSSQL"* OR *"stop Veeam"* OR *"stop BackupExec"* OR *"stop SQLWriter"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBAdmin.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete catalog"* OR *"delete backup"*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (
    (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/shadowcopy\s+delete/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures)/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+(catalog|backup|systemstatebackup)/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\powershell\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(DisableRealtimeMonitoring|DisableIOAVProtection|DisableBehaviorMonitoring|Set-MpPreference|Add-MpPreference\s+-ExclusionPath)/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\sc\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(WinDefend|Sense|WdNisSvc)/i AND CommandLine=/(stop|disabled|delete)/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\(net|taskkill)\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(MSSQL|SQLWriter|Veeam|BackupExec|sqlservr|agntsvc)/i)
  )
| UserName!=/\$$/
| case {
    CommandLine=/(shadow|recoveryenabled|bootstatuspolicy|wbadmin.*delete)/i | Action:="recovery_destruction";
    CommandLine=/(DisableRealtimeMonitoring|Set-MpPreference|Add-MpPreference|WinDefend|Sense|WdNisSvc)/i | Action:="defense_disable";
    CommandLine=/(MSSQL|SQLWriter|Veeam|BackupExec|sqlservr|agntsvc)/i | Action:="service_kill";
    * | Action:="other"
  }
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=[count(Action, distinct=true, as=DistinctActions), collect([Action, ImageFileName, CommandLine], multival=true), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen)])
| DistinctActions >= 2
| WindowSec := (LastSeen - FirstSeen) / 1000
| WindowSec <= 900

ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit affiliate exfiltration: StealBit / rclone / MEGAsync upload from servers prior to encryption
ucs.description: Hunts the LockBit double-extortion exfil stage: StealBit (LockBit's custom exfiltrator), rclone with MEGA/Google/S3 remotes, MEGAsync/MEGAcmd, or FreeFileSync running interactively on file/DC/SQL/Veeam servers — paired with outbound traffic to mega.nz / mega.io / pCloud / sync.com. Affiliates run StealBit/rclone as part of every LockBit 2.0/3.0 incident before encryption (documented by CISA AA23-325A and Red Canary's LockBit 'rclone playbook' write-ups).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as commands from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="rclone.exe" Processes.process IN ("*mega:*","*drive:*","*b2:*","*s3:*","*remote:*","*--config*","*--transfers*","*--multi-thread-streams*","*copy *","*sync *","*copyto *")) OR (Processes.process_name IN ("megasync.exe","megacmd.exe","megacmdserver.exe","megaclient.exe")) OR (Processes.process_name="freefilesync.exe" Processes.process IN ("*.ffs_batch*","*.ffs_gui*")) OR (Processes.process_name="stealbit.exe") OR (Processes.process IN ("*StealBit*","*stealbit*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | search NOT user IN ("*$","SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") | join type=left dest [ | tstats summariesonly=true count as net_count values(All_Traffic.dest) as remote_hosts from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest="*mega.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest="*mega.io" OR All_Traffic.dest="*mega.co.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest="*pcloud.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="*sync.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="*backblazeb2.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="userstorage.mega.co.nz") by All_Traffic.src | rename All_Traffic.src as dest ] | eval host_is_server=if(match(dest,"(?i)(DC|FS|SQL|VEEAM|BKP|BACKUP|SRV|FILE|HV|APP)"),1,0) | where host_is_server=1 OR net_count>0 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let ExfilTooling = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName =~ "rclone.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any (" mega:"," drive:"," b2:"," s3:"," remote:","--config","--transfers","--multi-thread-streams","--max-age") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("copy","sync","copyto","move"))
        or (FileName in~ ("megasync.exe","megacmd.exe","megacmdserver.exe","megaclient.exe"))
        or (FileName =~ "freefilesync.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any (".ffs_batch",".ffs_gui"))
        or (FileName matches regex @"(?i)stealbit")
        or (ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)stealbit")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service");
let CloudEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any ("mega.nz","mega.io","mega.co.nz","userstorage.mega","pcloud.com","sync.com","backblazeb2.com","file.io","anonfiles.com","transfer.sh","gofile.io")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, NetProc = InitiatingProcessFileName;
ExfilTooling
| join kind=leftouter (DeviceInfo | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, DeviceCategory, DeviceType, IsInternetFacing) by DeviceId) on DeviceId
| join kind=leftouter CloudEgress on DeviceId
| where isnull(NetTime) or NetTime between (Timestamp - 30m .. Timestamp + 2h)
| extend ServerHint = iif(DeviceName matches regex @"(?i)\b(dc|fs|sql|veeam|bkp|backup|srv|file|hv|app)\d*\b", "yes", "no")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, ServerHint, DeviceCategory, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, NetTime, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, NetProc, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc

| where isnull(NetTime) or NetTime between (Timestamp - 30m .. Timestamp + 2h)
